snippet.title: Everdeep Aurora Release Date Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: RELEASE DATE: In Everdeep Aurora you'll play as a kitten digging through the depths in search of her mother. Check out the demo at #SteamNextFest and enjoy a world free of combat, but full of secrets. Available July 10! https://s.team/a/2251400 #WholesomeDirect #SummerGameFest
